reproduction.result_before_fix: EXPECTED_RED: Missing expected rejection; the shared SemVer parser removed the first prerelease character before comparison

reproduction.result_before_fix: EXPECTED_RED: catalog next_cursor exposed the raw alpha-skill slug and detail had a fixed 100-row ceiling

root_cause.client: The existing shared SemVer parser sliced a prerelease token that no longer included the dash; exact version selection also searched only the bounded first detail page, and service/Host failures collapsed to free text.
root_cause.worker: Catalog cursors exposed raw slugs, detail and owned reads used fixed LIMIT 100 queries, model-session sid was validated but discarded, deflate output was fully materialized before its declared expansion size was checked, and a publish mutation receipt did not consult the immutable tombstone.
root_cause.resolution: The existing Skill Hub component and Worker paths now use signed filter-bound keyset cursors, exact immutable version reads, Session-mixed one-time credential hashes, bounded streaming inflate, tombstone-aware mutation replay, exact publisher receipts and typed failures. The native FileSystemSkillProvider, per-slug serial owner, DSH Jobs and persistent WAL remain the only local facts.

contract_receipts.single_path: browser or Agent -> /emate.skillHub or typed Tool -> existing component -> managed identity Worker -> existing per-slug WAL -> rc.7 FileSystemSkillProvider -> native Job receipt/inventory
contract_receipts.catalog_detail_version: query/category/tag/source catalog and immutable version history use signed opaque keyset cursors; exact version has a dedicated GET route
contract_receipts.publication: installed native Skills and exact session .e-mate/imports/*.zip identities are accepted; arbitrary host paths, links, hardlinks and changed bytes are rejected
contract_receipts.browser_boundary: browser mutations remain Host RPC calls; Worker rejects Origin/Sec-Fetch bearer transport and emits no CORS grant
contract_receipts.install_credentials: install and completion token digests are mixed with the validated model-session sid ref; another Session cannot consume or complete them
contract_receipts.mutation_identity: publish/delete and install lifecycle receipts show exact slug, version, content digest and publisher; tombstoned publish replay is conflict, not a false 201
contract_receipts.local_lifecycle: install/update/downgrade/enable/disable/uninstall share one slug serializer and WAL; update downgrade is explicit; restart recovery reconciles before candidate activation
contract_receipts.native_invocation: an installed fixture Skill is loaded by the pinned rc.7 model-facing native skill Tool
contract_receipts.publication_delete_separation: deleting a remote publication leaves the local installed Skill intact; local uninstall is a separate lifecycle mutation
contract_receipts.inventory_refresh: Capability UI rereads receipt/provider inventory after completed, failed or killed native Job terminal state
contract_receipts.download_credential: Host issues at most 32 random five-minute credentials; HEAD does not consume, first verified GET consumes, and digest is rechecked before response
